speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: I did not ask for the KPI definition itself to be automated, only the hand over of that definition into the ingestion pipeline. Automating the definition logic is a separate task that risks locking in the wrong heatwave thresholds before we have validated them.
output.correction: You are misreading my request as a demand for full automation of the metric logic. I am specifically asking for the automated transfer of the existing, manually reviewed KPI parameters to the data ingestion layer so we can capture real time shifts.
